# [TASK] Close out the remaining config-service production-readiness items

## Task
The README's "Production Considerations" list still carries two unfinished
items for this service: item 4 (access control on the config endpoints) and
the handling of unrecognised paths, which currently resolve through the
config server's catch-all mapping and answer 200 instead of 404. The second
one also means a probe pointed at a mistyped path reports healthy.

Close out both, and keep the Docker and Kubernetes profiles behaving the same
as they do today.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Access to the config endpoints follows the README's outstanding production item, configurable per environment and off by default for local development
- [ ] An unrecognised path returns 404 rather than a config document
- [ ] Actuator health, readiness, liveness and the Prometheus scrape path keep working unchanged
- [ ] The existing test suite and the Docker profile still pass

## Estimate
**Hours:** 3
